It is believed that the name is derived from the historic Mount Meru, a sacred peak believed to be the residence of the gods in Hindu mythology. The name carries the connotation of divine strength, stability, and spiritual elevation, making it a source of pride for families with this lineage.

With the roots of the name coming from the Tamil word 'Meru,' denoting the sacred and pious mountain, it is believed that the name Merugu bestows the spirit of mercy upon its bearer. Moreover, the presence of the prefix 'Gu,' which signifies god, strengthens the spiritual significance of the name. This name serves as a constant reminder of the divine qualities of mercy, compassion, and grace, instilling a sense of humility and reverence among those who carry it.
